name: Drupal Module Upgrader
description: Drush tooling that scans a Drupal 7 module's source, reports what must change for modern Drupal (with links to change records), and automatically rewrites the mechanically-convertible parts in place.
provides_plugin_types: Indexer (Plugin/DMU/Indexer, @Indexer) - read-only scanners that build an in-memory map of the target module (functions, classes, constants, function calls, hook implementations)
Analyzer (Plugin/DMU/Analyzer, @Analyzer) - read-only checks that flag Issues with a message, source locations, tags and drupal.org change-record links
Converter (Plugin/DMU/Converter, @Converter) - in-place rewriters that translate D7 constructs (hooks, info file, function calls) to modern equivalents; DEPRECATED in favor of Fixers
Fixer (Plugin/DMU/Fixer, @Fixer) - small isolated Pharborist-backed code transformations (create class, implement hook, delete node, define, notify)
Rewriter (Plugin/DMU/Rewriter, @Rewriter) - type-aware parametric search-and-replace that rewrites a function body based on a known parameter type's getters/setters
Route converter (Plugin/DMU/Routing, @Converter) - converts hook_menu route items into routing YAML plus controller/form routes
project_description:
Drupal Module Upgrader (DMU) provides Drush commands to scan the source of a Drupal 7 module, flag any code that requires updating to modern Drupal, point off to the relevant API change notices at https://www.drupal.org/list-changes/, and (where possible) actually attempt to convert the Drupal 7 code automatically to modern Drupal.

The module is kept on life support to aid Drupal 7 upgraders; further development is not planned. It runs on modern Drupal (core ^10 || ^11) but its target is Drupal 7 source code. It depends on the Pharborist PHP parser, cebe/markdown and doctrine/collections, installed via Composer (minimum-stability dev).

Usage: place the Drupal 7 module you wish to port into your modern site's /modules directory, then run `drush dmu-analyze MODULE_NAME` for a report of what needs changing, or `drush dmu-upgrade MODULE_NAME` to attempt the automatic conversions in place.
